name: Choose the Door
description: Pick-a-door reveal short — two doors, a beat of suspense, the choice pays off. Analog-tinged comparison framing rendered end-to-end.
referenceNotes: If remixing a specific source clip, ref-pull it for the cut blueprint + reusable keyframes. The two brands' identities lock via multi-ref (master + character + source-frame) on every gemini gen.

slots.description: The SAFE / winning brand (calm accent side, no meter).
The BAD / losing brand (opposite accent, the side the gauge drains on).
Calm-side accent HEX (e.g. red = safe here).
The draining-gauge label (LIMITS / CREDITS / TOKENS / ...), the BAD side's core device.
Per-beat kinetic caption lines (the silent narration).
End-card line + the SAFE brand mark.
Optional source video to remix the cut blueprint from.
Overlay display/HUD font (VT323-style retro mono by default).

doNotCopyLiterally: Single root composition: sequential clips on ONE track 0, overlays as always-present divs gated by the GSAP timeline. Build the gauge as scaleX fill + proxy-tween percent counter (slow drain then 1s crash). Keep ALL text as a HyperFrames overlay, never baked into gemini frames. Lock identity with multi-ref (master + character + source-frame) on every gen. Hold ONE aesthetic end-to-end. Ken-Burns push-in on every still; 0.5s crossfades, never hard cuts. VHS / grade is a post-process ffmpeg pass, not in-composition.
stackSummary: google/gemini-3-pro-image-preview multi-ref for location/character identity lock (~$0.15/img); bytedance/seedance-2.0 for first+last-frame plunges (~$0.14/s); alibaba/wan-2.7 for cheap 9:16 push-ins (~$0.10/s); ElevenLabs (subscription) for VO/music/SFX. HyperFrames single composition for the cut + overlays; ffmpeg VHS/grade post-pass + x264 CRF23 compress. ~$13.85 total in the source.
